roadmap.title: Full story run with collection
roadmap.description: Play all 20 levels of Acts I-V once. In every level collect all experience points and pick up the Letters, Hats, Bags, and Tidbits listed in their guides, plus the level-specific feats. The 1800 experience points are exactly enough to buy every skill for all three heroes.

roadmap.title: Free-roam cleanup
roadmap.description: After the credits you can freely re-enter every level. Use level select to replay a level for the damage-free, box-free, and dry-river feats, and to finish the skill-dependent combat feats once the required skills are bought.

achievements.description: Use Amadeus's Spinning Ball to destroy a chilled enemy
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Destroy an enemy frozen by Pontius's clone using Amadeus's Spinning Ball.

guide.context: The freeze comes from Pontius's Exploding Clone. In its white mode the clone stands still instead of copying Pontius, and after a few seconds it gains a chill aura that freezes any enemy that touches it.

steps.text: Unlock Pontius's Exploding Clone and place the clone in its white standing mode.
Lure an enemy into the clone and wait for the chill aura to freeze the enemy.
Conjure @item{Amadeus's Spinning Ball} and hit the frozen enemy with it.
steps.note: Gemstone Caverns, Checkpoint 11 has a lone rat at a platform edge that is easy to freeze.

achievements.description: Destroy an enemy using a projectile from a Wall Spitter Plant
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a projectile launched by a Wall Spitter Plant.

guide.context: The timing is the hard part: the enemy has to be in the path of the plant's projectile at the moment it fires.

steps.text: Find a Wall Spitter Plant with an enemy nearby.
Shove the enemy into the plant's firing line with Pontius, or deflect the plant's projectile into the enemy with Pontius's shield.
Keep the enemy in the line of fire until a projectile kills it.
steps.note: A good spot is Gemstone Caverns, Checkpoint 12.

achievements.description: When a defeated Clockwork Mosquito is exploding, use the blast to destroy another Clockwork Mosquito
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Destroy a second Clockwork Mosquito with the blast from one you have already defeated.

guide.context: A defeated Clockwork Mosquito detonates a moment after it dies, and the explosion can kill any other mosquito inside its radius.

steps.text: Bring two Clockwork Mosquitoes close together; three spawn together at The Astral Academy Gardens, Checkpoint 9.
Kill one mosquito and keep the other inside the blast until the explosion goes off.

achievements.description: During a single fight, make a Clockwork Guardian use the Spin Attack five times
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Make a Clockwork Guardian perform its Spin Attack five times in one fight.

guide.context: The Clockwork Guardian is the knight-type enemy that whirls its weapon when you approach. All five uses must happen before that same fight ends.

steps.text: Start a fight with a Clockwork Guardian.
Step into its melee range to prompt a spin, then jump or move out of range to survive it.
Bait the spin until the Guardian has used it five times in the fight.
steps.note: At Checkpoint 4 of The Long Way to Town a Guardian sits behind a barrier, so you can retreat after each spin.

achievements.description: Cross all the rivers in the Long Way to Town without touching the water
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Reach the end of The Long Way to Town without ever touching the river water.

guide.context: The optional Pontius section counts toward this feat, and the run only counts if you begin the level from its start; loading a later checkpoint does not.

steps.text: Begin The Long Way to Town from the very start of the level.
Cross every river without letting a hero fall in, including the extra Pontius section.
steps.note: Some movement skills are effectively required for clean river crossings, so attempt this after unlocking them.

achievements.description: Complete a level without breaking any of the Wooden Boxes
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Finish a level without breaking any Wooden Boxes.

guide.context: Every level that holds Wooden Boxes needs at least one broken to reach all of its experience, so plan this as a separate clean replay rather than part of a collection run.

steps.text: Replay a level and take a route that leaves its Wooden Boxes intact.
Reach the end of the level without smashing a single box.
steps.note: The Garden of Eternal Shade is a reasonable choice, with moderate enemies and boxes you can walk past.

achievements.description: Complete a level without taking any damage
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Finish a level from Act II onward without taking any damage.

guide.context: The first three levels never count for this feat, and any hit from an enemy, trap, or fall ruins the run, so the whole level has to stay clean.

steps.text: Choose any level from The Astral Academy Gardens onward.
Complete that level without being hit; restart from the beginning if you take any damage.
steps.note: The Long Way to Town is a moderate option once you have a few movement skills.

achievements.description: Conjure a box to comply with the Shopkeeper's request in The Tallest Tower
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Satisfy the Shopkeeper in The Tallest Tower by conjuring a box with Amadeus.

guide.context: The request happens in the town at the start of The Tallest Tower, before the climb to the castle, when the townspeople recognize the heroes.

steps.text: Start The Tallest Tower and reach the town shopkeeper who asks the heroes for a box.
Switch to Amadeus and conjure a box in front of the shopkeeper.

achievements.description: Charge the Church Bell in the Garden of Eternal Shade
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Ring the giant Church Bell during The Garden of Eternal Shade with repeated charge attacks.

guide.context: The bell hangs on the top level of the cathedral platforms, past the main hall.

steps.text: Inside the cathedral of The Garden of Eternal Shade, leave the main hall and climb to the top platform level.
Use Pontius's charge attack on the giant bell repeatedly until it rings and the achievement appears.

achievements.description: Deliver the Pie from the Red Rose Inn to the end of the level
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Bring the pie served at the Red Rose Inn all the way to the finish of The Long Way to Town.

guide.context: The pie sits on a table during the fight against the impostor heroes near the end of the level, and it is effectively indestructible, so combat and drops will not destroy it.

steps.text: During the Red Rose Inn fight in The Long Way to Town, pick up the pie with Amadeus's levitation.
Carry the pie to the level exit and finish the level.
steps.note: If you drop the pie, simply levitate it again; it does not break.

achievements.description: Find the Dancing Mushrooms in the Autumn Woods
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Find the dancing mushrooms hidden inside a tree in Autumn Woods.

guide.context: The hiding spot is under the fallen tree you use to climb a platform shortly after Checkpoint 2; entering the hollow triggers the achievement.

steps.text: Progress Autumn Woods past Checkpoint 2 and knock down the tree that lets you climb up.
Instead of climbing over the platform, follow the tree trunk to go underneath and inside it.
Enter the hidden den where the mushrooms are dancing.

achievements.description: Don't let Kraken's tentacles hit you in the Smuggler's Way
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Reach the end of Smuggler's Way without the Kraken's tentacles hitting you.

guide.context: During the submarine crash near the end of the level the tentacles slam marked spots; the ground glows just before each impact, showing where to move away from.

steps.text: Progress to the submarine crash near the end of Smuggler's Way.
Watch for each patch of ground to light up and step clear before the tentacle lands, taking no hits through the whole sequence.

achievements.description: Meet all the three Astral Observatory Wizards
achievements.summary: Meet each of the three Astral Observatory Wizards.

guide.context: The meetings happen as the story unfolds and are tracked on the local save. In online co-op a client that joins with a fresh save can lose credit for wizards met in earlier sessions, so rejoin with the correct existing save if the achievement does not appear.

steps.text: Play through the story and meet each of the three Astral Observatory Wizards when they appear.

achievements.description: Defeat the Clockwork Knights posing as the Heroes of Trine in the Red Rose Inn
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Beat the fake Heroes of Trine waiting inside the Red Rose Inn, who are Clockwork Knights in disguise.

guide.context: The impostors wait near the end of The Long Way to Town. You can run past them to the window instead, so you must choose to stay and win the fight.

steps.text: Reach the Red Rose Inn near the end of The Long Way to Town.
Fight and defeat the Clockwork Knights dressed as the three heroes instead of running to the window.

achievements.description: Destroy two enemies with a single arrow
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Kill two enemies with one arrow.

guide.context: This depends on Zoya's Trick Shot skill, and both enemies must die from that one arrow, so weaken two targets and line them up before firing.

steps.text: Unlock Zoya's Trick Shot.
Find two weak or already-damaged enemies, such as rats, and line them up.
Fire one arrow that kills both lined-up enemies with the single shot.
steps.note: Autumn Woods, Checkpoint 8 leaves you alone with just two rats, an easy setup.

achievements.description: Destroy an enemy using an unarmed Pontius Clone
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with Pontius's clone while Pontius fights bare-handed.

guide.context: This needs Pontius's Prismatic Talisman clone and the Sword Throw skill. The clone only attacks bare-handed once Pontius has thrown his sword away.

steps.text: Unlock Pontius's Prismatic Talisman and Sword Throw.
Place the clone in the red mode that copies Pontius, then throw Pontius's sword away.
Let the unarmed clone defeat an enemy.
steps.note: The skeletons summoned by the necromancer at The Garden of Eternal Shade, Checkpoint 7 are good targets.

achievements.description: Use Amadeus to destroy a Clockwork Mosquito with a conjured item
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Destroy a Clockwork Mosquito using an item conjured by Amadeus.

guide.context: The conjured item has to land the killing blow, and Amadeus's flat board is the easiest conjuration to aim at a low-flying mosquito.

steps.text: Have Amadeus conjure a flat board near a Clockwork Mosquito.
Smash the board onto the mosquito and let the conjured board kill it.
steps.note: Petrified Marshes around Checkpoint 2 has mosquitoes to practice on.

achievements.description: How far can you go with Pontius's Shield Sliding?
achievements.sortReason: Optional feat; do it when the required skill or level is available.
achievements.summary: Slide a long distance in one go with Pontius's Shield Sliding.

guide.context: The feat measures distance rather than time, and the long uneven downhill stretch in The Astral Academy Gardens gives the cleanest uninterrupted slide.

steps.text: Unlock Pontius's Shield Sliding.
In The Astral Academy Gardens, continue past the Lady Sunshine laser cutscene to the first platforming section with uneven ground.
Start from the higher side and slide left on the shield, keeping the slide going until the achievement appears.
